name: Studio C

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 1
videos.overview: Dalton and Tori set off on an adventure to recruit a new cast for Studio C. With a new cast in place, investors check out Lin-Manuel Miranda's latest Broadway project about William Henry Harrison, the president that died after thirty days in office. Then, Dalton Johnson plays every character in a spoof of Downton Abbey. Later, Rapunzel is thrown for a loop when a prince climbs up her hair to join her in her tower. Finally, a standard union meeting is taken over by a troupe of soap opera actors.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 2
videos.overview: An attention-starved bystander intrudes on an urgent news story; Guy Fieri, who's on the quest for tasty food in the South, runs into a dive he can't escape; and an animatronic Lincoln puts a Disneyland heckler back in his place.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 3
videos.overview: Abraham Lincoln dishes out the honest truth on Say Yes to the Dress. Bigfoot infiltrates a group of Bigfoot hunters. And a dimwitted mob member “takes care of” a snitch.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 4
videos.overview: An internet rabbit hole distracts a lawyer from his murder case. A couple swaps out their ordinary home for a glorified porta-potty. And a musical virtuosos perform Beethoven's “Moonlight Sonata” on piano and melodica.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 5
videos.overview: After being brought to life by a mad scientist, Frankenstein is slammed with medical bills. And an Unscented Place features a world in which the sense of smell can be very dangerous.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 6
videos.overview: Dora the Middle-Age Explorer's next adventure takes her into the world of dating apps. In another adventure, athletes sweat in a rainbow of colors. And on The Today Show, Kathie Lee and Hoda both fail a personality test.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 7
videos.overview: Sick in bed, a kid is powerless to stop his mom from taking over his YouTube channel.  The only thing worse than a natural disaster is the press conference about it. And a family is torn apart and drawn together in this Home School Musical.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 8
videos.overview: Grandpa Joe turns on everyone when Charlie invites him to Wonka's Chocolate Factory. Mary Poppins is hired by the Banks children to work in their office. And Chopin's “Prelude in E minor” is performed on a stylophone.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 9
videos.overview: Clark Kent struggles to meet his deadline, a group secretly dances to disco music, Clint Dilly blames legs for a woman’s missing husband, Roman senators plot to kill Caesar, a man watches a video before surgery and puberty shocks middle schoolers.

videos.title: Season 10 Episode 10
videos.overview: A not so motivational speaker visits an elementary school. Communication breaks down at a college apartment when one roommate has strange meanings for common acronyms. And Hansel and Gretel question the witch's cooking abilities and home life.

videos.title: Season 10 Christmas Special

videos.title: Season 11 Episode 1
videos.overview: An appendix tries to be included within the vital organs of the body. Two inflatable tube men at a car lot discuss the issues in their lives. And Mr. Science is back to demonstrate the explosive activity of a volcano.

videos.title: Season 11 Episode 2
videos.overview: A seemingly normal courtroom scene is transformed when the cast starts kissing each other. A one-dollar donation unwittingly commits a college student to fight Hunger. A customer tests the patience of a grocery checkout clerk with his determination to score free stuff. A hedge fund manager takes the stage at a slam poetry competition. And a disgruntled sandwich shop employee has high expectations for her customers.

videos.title: Season 11 Episode 3
videos.overview: A homeowner believes her house is haunted, but the ghost is even more haunted when he discovers that the Revolutionary War didn't go the way he thought it had. A middle schooler wonders if her appearance on a local cooking show is more of a punishment than a reward. And Belle is startled by the enchanted objects in Beast's castle, especially the one object no one ever talks about.

videos.title: Season 11 Episode 4
videos.overview: Buckle up your rodeo belts, put on your best boots, and come on out to an old-fashioned, hoedown!  Then brace yourself for a dramatic look at the lives of housewives on the prairie. Get caught up in a magic show with the finest magician and assistant around.  Join a family, and their newly found hitchhiker, on a road trip.  And test your mothering knowledge on the hit game show "Causes and Cures."

videos.title: Season 11 Episode 5
videos.overview: The stakes are high, leading one ballroom dancer to lose control. Then, The Wright Brothers take control of the sky, and the patrons of the sky in a historical documentary. And on the topic of transportation, after falling on the subway tracks, a man's survival is left to strangers. Next, the secret to time travel is discovered, which is probably how one restaurant is prepared to celebrate everything, and King Henry VIII makes a special appearance on The Newlywed Game.

videos.title: Season 11 Episode 6
videos.overview: Sometimes everything just seems to go wrong. A restaurant can't get an order right. Sherlock's infamous deductive reasoning doesn't help him talk to women.  High schoolers attempt to rewrite Shakespeare. Four millennials can't make their way out of an escape room. And finally, a game night leaves two couples questioning their communication skills.

videos.title: Season 11 Episode 7
videos.overview: A breakroom is home to two cryogenically frozen heads. Unable to handle the grief, a man tries to liven up a funeral with a game of Twister. A man dramatically quits his job and storms out but then realizes his actions may have been premature.

As a cruise ship sinks, a less than heroic captain oversees the vessel's evacuation.
